rules: RestoreCorpseItems remains item-only and never consumes corpse gold.
RestoreCorpseForResurrection requires the corpse character identity.
Gold restoration occurs only when restoreGold is explicitly true.
The result reports restored gold; Character or Economy owns crediting character currency.
A corpse finalizes only when no corpse-root items and no gold remain.
All item and corpse mutations roll back together on failure.
